No intentional false curve, no answer key, no guessed source coordinates and no original PNG. The display window is x=[-1,11], y=[-5,7], not a domain restriction. Square-root domain is x>=0; visible square-root segment is x=[0,11]. sqrt-curve uses the exact quadratic parametric Bezier x=11*t^2, y=sqrt(11)*t, 0<=t<=1. RHS is the full affine line y=6-x, clipped only by the coordinate frame; the x=9 tick remains visible without highlighting. Numeric unit labels; the reciprocal grid has half-unit cells. All learner-facing text is ASCII, 20 px at width 640. No intersection point, solution coordinate, projected intersection guide or answer-bearing annotation. The supported assertion vocabulary does not prove arbitrary svgPath identities; exact construction and sampling checks are in the separately hash-bound mathematical receipt, not misrepresented as validator proof.
